authority.semantic_owner: Dr. Cheng decision authority with reward-engineering-lab

objective.baseline: same sealed Scenario and executed Clean-conditioned outcome semantics
objective.horizon: one Repair action followed by the active K-step Segment consequence
objective.evidence_scope: executed Repair physical outcome relative to the same Clean support semantics
parameters_receiving_credit: FrontRES full-6D Repair Actor through the active Gain consumer

relations.condition: compare two valid Repair outcomes for the same Scenario
relations.left: Repair with no survival failure, no expected-support no-load, and no unplanned support switch
relations.right: Repair with at least one of those severe violations

relations.condition: left is no worse on all three severe violations and strictly improves at least one
relations.left: severe-violation vector that Pareto-dominates the right vector

relations.condition: both Repairs have zero severe violations; left is no worse on every defined ordinary item and strictly improves at least one
relations.left: ordinary outcome vector that Pareto-dominates the right vector

incomparable_cases.left: Repair improves one severe violation but introduces or worsens another severe violation
incomparable_cases.right: Repair preserves the first severe item but is better on the second
incomparable_cases.reason: the Design Inspector decision does not define a severity priority between different severe violation families

incomparable_cases.left: severe-clear Repair improves some ordinary items and worsens others
incomparable_cases.right: another severe-clear Repair with the opposite ordinary tradeoff
incomparable_cases.reason: no human-confirmed scalar tradeoff weights exist between ordinary items
